name: measure
description: A measure with its ISO/IEC/IEEE 15939 metadata: information need, consumer, base or derived, function, decision criterion. Read from what defines it (the SLOs of config/registry/slo.json, the measure of each validation, the cheaper-path measure of D-327). Catalog conformance checks wiring, metadata and freshness; a breached SLO or an unmet cheaper-path target is a significant operational weakness that keeps measurement below F and open.
